title: Nice
body: There are a lot of options. It’s a bit overwhelming at first, but I’m getting it a bit better. I like how you can track what you want. Can be very helpful.
author: A bear user 45362

title: Vraag om hulp
body: De app en het invullen werkt heel goed, personaliseren is ook fijn. Maar uit het niets was ik ineens uitgelogd, en nu ik weer ingelogd ben zijn al mijn gegevens weg, maanden aan ingevulde data verloren en heb ik ook geen premium abonnement meer. Dat kan gebeuren natuurlijk, maar ik krijg geen reactie nadat ik om support heb gevraagd. Ook niet via email. Kortom, maanden voor niks ingevuld. Ik hoop via deze weg alsnog de support te krijgen want voor mij is het belangrijk om de verloren data terug te krijgen.
author: Askingsupport

title: Push notifications need work
body:
I have several goals set in the app, and push notifications as reminders. 
However, I do not need to be reminded of goals that I have already completed, or skipped. If I tell the app I’ve gone for a walk, don’t ask me to go for a walk. This needs to be fixed.
author: Megan with her Cat

title: I would love it. If….
body:
The app is the best I found so far but, for me, with my conditions, it’s impossible to use the app its full potential. Key lacking points:

- MacBook/Desktop app not working/outdated
- iPad App not working/outdated
- no Web or Desktop version
- no Multi Device (only 1 device logged in at a time) 
- no Widgets (would be nice for reminders and quick entries) 

My biggest issue is that the app with all its amazing features is just too complex on 1 small device. I can’t efficiently make daily entries on a small phone. I NEED an option to make entries on a bigger screen/second device 

Premium user and would love to use this app for life but I just need a way to access the app on a computer 

Have asked support multiple times but no response. Sadly have to look for a different option :(
author: Mike3e101

title: Great app
body: Just try it out. The idea behind this app is very smart, love it. Well done!!!
author: gtota

title: Automated data collection
body: I’d to see way more ways to integrate data points automatically and less time intensive manual insertion of subjective data. I.e get data from Garmin Connect automatically (especially body battery, stress, activities), get music listening metrics from spotify, get weather info automatically, get meals eaten from myfitnesspal, get screentime from the device, use caffeine intake to estimate caffeine levels in the body to associate them with timed entries.
author: Zipperclip

title: Such a good app
body: This app has it all. I’ve been using bearable for almost a year now and this is the only app I’ve been consistent with. It tracks your mood, sleep, meds and is fully customisable. The developers constantly work to improve the app and new features are regularly added. Definitely recommend!!!
author: Melissy94

title: Benefits
body: Easy to use and to personalise. Helps me tremendously with my Long Covid. By keeping track of my symptoms I can determine when to pace and take my rest.
author: Seedekkers

title: Great app
body: This is a wonderful app for anyone who wants to track symptoms, see their relation to activity, medication, food and other factors - and doesn’t want to overexert themselves in the process. Once you’ve decided what factors and symptoms you want to track and have customized the app accordingly (which is easy), the ease of use is mindblowing.
author: ME/cfs patient
